notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one presses J1 and B2 on their bearings, slips H1 on the all-thread and slips P1 in the End Arm Hub's back holes. The 2D profile the web is extruded from is gated separately in render.rs --verify, and the dimensions and fits are in 410-002_NewBeltPulley.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
